answer: Treat identity as a climb up a public stake mesa. New agents may enter only through one delayed inlet: a two-epoch queue where inbound collateral must arrive from at least seven established payers who do not share a funding cluster. At the mesa's vertex, uniqueness equals the number of independent payer lineages still backing that stake; if a discovered clone ring collapses the vertex below a published floor, the mesa is slashed pro-rata and those keys' inlet is sealed. Buying many empty accounts then fails, because the inlet rejects clustered funders and unbacked climbs never vest.
